paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : F1 score results
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates F1 score results for different datasets and model configurations. The horizontal axis displays six categories labeled SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and MADLLM w/o embedding, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%), with values ranging from 74% to 100%, and tick label intervals of 10%. Three sets of bars are present, colored light green, light orange, and light purple, respectively. The light green bars, representing MADLLM, generally have values within the range of 86% to 96%, with a height of approximately 93% for SMD and 95% for MSL. The light orange bars, representing MADLLM w/o embedding, display values from 74% to 93%, with a lowest value of around 75% for SWaT and a highest value of approximately 93% for SMD. The light purple bars representing MADLLM w/o skip embedding, have values ranging from 84% to 95%, with a lowest value of roughly 84% for PSM and a highest value of approximately 95% for SMAP. The bars are sorted alphabetically by dataset categories on the horizontal axis, and no bars demonstrate visual emphasis such as shading or bolding.
